choose.iem-hd: You want the established, safe IEM default with light crossfeed.
choose.iem-v4: You want a wider, more spatial image and accept HRIR crossfeed colouring.
choose.iem-v10: You want straight dual-mono with no crossfeed, closest to the plain target.
choose.spk-v6: You want the most protective speaker setup, led by convolver correction.
choose.spk-v8: You mostly watch video and want clearer dialogue and some width.
choose.spk-v10: You want maximum loudness from the speaker and accept more limiter activity.
